title: Adaptive Version Gating and Customer Migration Sprint
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: deliver a coordinated, low-friction migration experience for customers affected by the upcoming runtime-1.20 variant gating. This ticket defines the adaptive gating strategy (per-customer windows + risk tiers), the cross-functional launch plan (docs, console banners, SDK warnings, release notes), and the escalation/runbook for any regressions. We aim to avoid a large simultaneous cutover by providing staged enforcement, self-serve migration tooling, and a concierge beta for high-risk tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive gating policy documented and approved by Eng & Sec
Console migration assistant UI spec completed and developer story created
Release notes draft and translation ticket created in localizers board
Automated warning header implemented in SDKs + server-side compatibility header
Support runbook with escalation matrix authored and validated in war-room drill
At least one enterprise customer completes self-serve migration in the concierge cohort
tasks: Define gating tiers (Early Adopters / Standard / Enterprise Holdouts) with criteria
Create in-console migration assistant mockups (DES-ops) and UX acceptance criteria
Implement server-side compatibility header: X-Redwood-Compatibility: v1.20-shim
Add SDK deprecation warnings with links to migration guide (node, python, java)
Author step-by-step migration playbook + rollback instructions for Support
Coordinate release notes copy and feature matrix for runtime-1.20
Schedule 2-week concierge migrations with account execs for 5 largest tenants
Prepare comms calendar: pre-notice, 30/14/7/1 day reminders, in-console banner
Create metrics dashboard (Console) to monitor migration progress and errors
Run a simulated rollback drill with Eng and SRE teams
milestones: 2025-02-27: Console assistant spec and mockups delivered
2025-03-07: SDK warning flag merged (PR #1248) and beta released
2025-03-14: Release notes and localized strings ready for review
2025-04-15: Enforcement + cutover complete and retrospective scheduled
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Enterprise tenants depend on deprecated wire-format -> Mitigation: concierge migrations + compatibility header
Risk: Docs out of sync leading to failed migrations -> Mitigation: locked doc review sprint & localized sign-off
Risk: Rollout triggers SLA regressions -> Mitigation: staged enforcement + automated fallback to v1.19 for specific routes
Risk: Support overload during peak migration -> Mitigation: temporary on-call rota + pre-authored runbooks
notes: We intentionally avoid a single global cutover. The adaptive gating lets us monitor real signals (error rate, latencies, support tickets) and pause progression for specific segments. Requirements for engineering: compatibility header, per-tenant flagging, and opt-out windows. Docs must include quick-fix code snippets and a dry-run checklist.
